scope: Frozen classifier-only matched comparison on historically inspected held test images

aggregation.single_architecture_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of five probability vectors per architecture, then argmax. Each row is one architecture with five pretrained/fine-tuned checkpoints, NOT one checkpoint.
aggregation.combined_aggregation: Each frozen fold routes E/E+S/E+G/E+G+S with its existing validation-selected assets; apply unchanged app.aggregate protected five-fold plurality vote to each variant. No new gate, specialist, thresholds or weights.
aggregation.paired_fold_analysis: Additionally report each architecture and variant separately in each original fold and arithmetic means of those metrics on the SAME test images. These folds are not independent seeds or five disjoint test subsets.
aggregation.api_abstention: No quality/OOD rejection, Grad-CAM, RAG or HTTP in this CLASSIFIER-ONLY test. It is not an API accuracy or speed comparison.

paired_bootstrap.limitation: Proxy-group bootstrap of fixed predictions only; not new patients, training seeds, adaptive-selection adjustment or clinical evidence.
